# Report a bug on Meta Quest

19 Likes

Updated:4 weeks ago

Please note that because of the high volume of feedback, we do not provide individual follow-up or responses.

Reporting a bug helps Meta to understand and resolve the problem. If you discover a broken feature or bug while using Meta Quest headset, you can send us a report from your headset or the Meta Horizon mobile app.

Meta Quest

Meta Horizon mobile app

To report a bug from your Meta Quest:

1. Press  Meta button or  Oculus button on your right controller to open the Navigator.
2. Select  Quick controls.
3. Select  Report headset issue.
4. Select Include or Don't include to add complete logs and diagnostics.
5. Follow the instructions to submit your report. [...] We use this information to better understand and fix the issues you're reporting. These reports are stored for up to 90 days and are automatically deleted after that.

Your choice to include complete logs and diagnostics is independent and separate from the control to share additional data with Meta when using Meta Quest devices.

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, we encourage you to let us know right away by reporting it via Meta’s Bug Bounty Program. If valid, you might be eligible to receive a payout for reporting the vulnerability to us.

## Troubleshooting

If you are experiencing problems, these articles can help you to troubleshoot common issues: [...] You can also quickly press the  Meta button /  Oculus button on your right Touch controller five times in a row to open the bug report tool.

  

## What information do we collect when someone reports a bug?

When someone reports a bug with Meta Quest we collect:

 Account level information
 Apps the person is running
 Basic information about the device

## What information can someone choose to include when reporting a bug?

When someone reports a bug with Meta Quest they can also choose to include complete logs and diagnostics, such as:

 Activity logs
 Network logs
 Thermals
 Battery performance
 Memory usage
 OS level systems
 Apps running and errors you have experienced

results.title: Report a problem with your organisation-managed Meta Quest | Quest help | Meta (en-gb)
results.content:
1. Press Meta button/  Oculus button on your right Touch controller to open your Navigator. 
    If your controllers aren't working, then you can use the white dot in the centre of your headset's view as a cursor and the volume buttons on your Meta Quest to select.
2. Select Quick controls from the System bar.
3. Select Report problem.
4. When prompted with: Include complete logs and diagnostics in this report?, select Include or Don't include.
5. Select a category for the problem.
6. Select a type of problem.
7. Add a description, choose whether to include a screenshot, and choose whether to add a photo or video. Then, click Continue.
8. Choose whether to include system information (including packages installed, memory usage and breakdown), then select Send report. [...] # Report a problem with your organisation-managed Meta Quest

19 likes

Updated:4 weeks ago

This article is for people who are using a device that's managed by an organisation, not for people who want to report a bug on a personal device.

When you report a problem on the device that's managed by your organisation, a bug report is created for an admin to review. This bug report is also sent to Meta.

To report a problem from your headset: [...] Note: If you are using an organisation-managed Meta Quest, then you cannot contact support. An admin for your organisation can send a support request in Admin Centre on your behalf.
